pages.title: Ephemeral Photon Ore
pages.text: Glints of light that do not come from anywhere. Virtual photons, the messengers that carry the electromagnetic force, wink in and out of this vein, so the ore glows without a source. It is cool to the touch despite the sparkle.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Every electric force is an exchange of virtual photons. Working in foam substrate I saw a seam lit from within, though nothing nearby could be lighting it. The vacuum was lending light and briefly forgetting to take it back.
$(thing)Found$(): in veins through the Quantum Foam (mine it for its drop).
